title: Adic formal completions, formal spectra and affine-chart regularity
statement: For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] and a quasi-coherent ideal $I$ [pqf-def-coherent], form the diagram $n\mapsto V(I^n)$ with the canonical closed inclusions for $n\le m$, using ideal sheaf powers [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. Define the adic formal completion $\widehat X_I$ as its colimit in ringed spaces. Thus its space is $V(I)$ and its structure sheaf is $\varprojlim_n\mathcal O_X/I^n$; on affine opens this is the adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. For $f:Y\to X$ and $I\mathcal O_Y\subseteq J$, the compatible canonical maps $V(J^n)\to V(I^n)$ induce $\widehat f:\widehat Y_J\to\widehat X_I$. For a ring $A$ and an ideal $K$, define $\operatorname{Spf}(A,K)$ as the completion of $\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] along the ideal sheaf generated by $K$. A formal affine open $U$ of a ringed space $Z$ is one whose coordinate ring $A=\mathcal O_Z(U)$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and complete and separated for a finitely generated ideal $K$, with $Z|_U\simeq\operatorname{Spf}(A,K)$. A Noetherian adic formal scheme admits a finite cover by such opens. It is reduced when all these coordinate rings are reduced, and quasi-excellent when they are quasi-excellent [def-exc-excellent-ring]. For a ringed-space morphism $g:W\to Z$ and opens $V\subseteq g^{-1}(U)$, its chart map is the structure map on $U$ followed by restriction to $V$. Define regularity on formal affines to mean that this chart map is regular [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] for every pair of formal affine opens $U,V$ and every such containment.
